title: Roxanne 065/067 s9a Battle Region Japanese Pokemon Mirror Holo Supporter
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Roxanne (Tsutsuji) - Pokemon Battle Region (s9a) - 065/067 - Japanese

You will receive the exact card pictured. These are photos of the actual card, not stock images. Front, back, and close-ups of all four corners are shown.

Card details:
- Name: Tsutsuji / Roxanne
- Card type: Trainer - Supporter
- Set: Battle Region (s9a), Japanese
- Card number: 065/067
- Rarity: U (Uncommon) - mirror holo / reverse holo
- Illustrator: Megumi Mizutani
- Regulation mark: F
- Copyright: (c) 2022 Pokemon / Nintendo / Creatures / GAME FREAK
- Language: Japanese

Card text (translated):
You can play this card only if your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining.
Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, you draw 6 cards and your opponent draws 2 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

Note for collectors and players: Roxanne is a well-known competitive Supporter, played as a late-game hand-disruption card. This copy is the mirror holo printing, with the foil pokeball pattern visible across the text box.

Condition: Ungraded, in the condition shown. Please review all photos closely and judge for yourself - the images are of the actual card and are the most accurate description of its condition. Corner close-ups are included so you can assess edge and corner wear directly.
